tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (539)sgrol ma'i gnas sbyong ye shes snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/(540)dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum/sna tshogs phrin las mthar phyin ma/sgrol ma yu
(539)sgrol ma'i gnas sbyong ye shes snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/(540)dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum/sna tshogs phrin las mthar phyin ma/sgrol ma yu

tei:div.tei:p: (539)sgrol ma'i gnas sbyong ye shes snang ba zhes bya ba bzhugs/ (540)

dus gsum sangs rgyas bskyed pa'i yum/ sna tshogs phrin las mthar phyin ma/ sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ gnas lung rim pa 'dir bshad bya/ sgrol ma ser sngo bsod nams mchog ster go sgo nas tshe 'das gnas sbyang gi cho ga bya ba la dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'i bya brnams tshogs su tshud par byas te/ skabs 'dir dgos pa'i sbyo ba'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par byas/ de nas bdag mdun 'jug pa gcig gi cho gas bskyed nas bzlas pa sngon du song rjes/ khrus bum la dmigs nas/ swā bha was/ stong pa'i ngang las saṃ las padma/ a las zla ba'i steng du bhrūm̐ yig 'od du zhu ba las/ bhrūm̐ las 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas/ sprul pa'i zhing khams po ta la/ sna tshogs nor bu'i gzhal (541)med khang*/ gru bzhi sgo bzhi mtshan nyid rdzogs/ 'dod rnam pha gu rin chen phreng*/ mda' yab shar bu mjes pa'i tog sgo rgyan rgyu 'bras rta bab ldan/ drwa ba dra phyed 'phyang 'phrul dang*/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshatsan ba dan rgyan/ 'dod yon mchod sprin bsam mi khyab/ nang khyams gru chad glo 'bur bcas/ lte bar padma 'dab ma bzhi/ saṃ padma maṇḍal/ a tsaṇḍa maṇḍal/ dbus kyi padma'i gdan gyi steng*/ ser sngo bsod nams mchog chogs ster ma/ jam bu na da'i kha dog la/ rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes par spras/ 'dog med kyi rtsod pan can/ g.yas (542)pas mchog sbyin phyag rgya mjad/ g.yon pas dkon mchog sum mtshan rgyas/ sdong bu dang bcas utpal/ rin chen bum pas mtshan pa bsnams/ zhabs gnyis skyil krung phyed stabs bzhugs/ bye ba phrag brgya'i 'od kyi tshogs/ sku las 'phros pa de nyid las/ padma dkor ge sar bcas/ bdud rtsi zig ma 'phro ba'i steng*/ 'byung ngo'i stobs rnams zil gnon pa/ las dang sgrib pa rnams sbyang ba/ byang chub sems dpag med dang*/ sgrol rab tu zhi byed*/ dkar gsal chu shel phung po la/ zla ba shar ba lta bu'i mdog tshe 'das sdig sgrib zhi ba la/

byang chub sems kyi thugs ldan pas/ 'od zer dpag med spro bzhin bzhugs/ shar gyi 'dab mar pad zla'i steng*/ 'phags ma sngo sang nam mkha'i mdog g.yas pas tri shul thugs kar 'dzin/ g.yon pas (543)utpal sngon po bsnams/ lho phyogs 'dab mar pad zla'i steng*/ tshogs chen bsod nams mchog ster ma/ 'phags ma gser gyi kha dog can/ g.yas pas ral gri thugs kar 'dzin/ g.yon pas utpal ser po bsnams/ nub kyi 'dab mar pad zla'i steng*/ 'phags ma 'jig rten dbang byed ma/ dmar gsal bhan dhu ji wa'i mdog g.yas pas 'khor lo thugs kar 'dzin/ g.yon pas utpal dmar po bsnams/ byang phyogs 'dab ma pad zla'i steng*/ 'phags ma sna tshogs las byed ma/ mar gad dri ma med pa'i mdog g.yas pas gdung kar thugs kar 'dzin/ g.yon pas utpal ljang gu bsnams/ zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs/ kun kyang lang tsho dar la bab/ mtshan dpe 'od kyi phung por 'bar/ sems can don la bon (544)shug ldan/ bud med sgyu ma'i snyems 'chang zhing*/ thugs rjes chags pa'i spyan 'khyug shing*/ ma rnams ma 'jigs ma 'jigs zhes/ dbugs 'byin chen po sbyin par mdzad/ dkyil 'khor phyogs kyi sgo bzhi ru/ padma zla ba rgyas pa'i steng*/ pho brang skyong ba'i sgo ma bzhi/ lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrogs dril/ dkar ser dmar dang ljang ku'i mdog phyag gnyis rang rtags thugs kar 'dzin/ kun kyang drang srong khros pa'i nyams/ spyan zlum mche ba rnam par gtsigs/ dmar ser ral pa gyen du phyogs/ rgyal ba rnams kyi sku gsung thugs/ 'bru gsum ye shes srog dang bcas/ ye shes lnga bdag cod paṇa 'chang*/ gsal stong lhun grub chen por bsgom/ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni/ oṃ/ skyobs pa 'dog med pa yi/ thugs dam chen po'i dkyil 'khor nas/ smon lam stobs las 'khrungs pa'i sku/ sgrol (545)ma'i mtshan gyi rnga chen po/ zhing rnams kun tu rab grags ma/ rje btsun 'phags ma 'khor dang bcas pa/

dam tshig chen po'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ thugs rje'i dbang gis 'byon par 'tshal/ nyon mongs dri ma bsal ba dang*/ sdug bsngal thams cad sel byed cing*/ sems can rnams la sman slad du/ 'khor dang bcas pa gshegs su gsol/ oṃ sarba ta tha ga ārya ta re sa pa ri wa ra aye hya hi ma hā ka ru ṇi ka sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya st+waṃ/ ja hūm̐ bam̐ ho/ zhes drangs te/ padma tsant+ra sa ma ya st+waṃ/ a ti pu ho/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ/ 'jig rten khams ni rabs 'byams na/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin brlabs pa/ me tog bdug spos mar me dri/ zhal zas rol mo'i bye brag rnams/ mchod pa'i sprin gyi char chen po/ 'phags ma 'khor dang bcas pa 'bul/ bsod nams (546)ye shes tshogs rdzogs shing*/ las dang ye shes dngos grub stsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ārya ta re puṣpe sogs nas/ shabda pu ja me gha sa mu tra sa spha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ bstod pa ni/ hūm̐/ ljang mjes sprin gyi gur gseb nas/ sangs rgyas ma chags padma'i spyan/ gzhon nu mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar/ sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal bstod/ ces dang*/ sdig sgrib sbyong ba'i dmigs bzlas ni/ bdag mdun bum pa rje btsun mar gsal ba'i thugs kar utpal dang rig pa yi ge tam̐ yig dkar po'i mthar rtsa ba'i sngags chu shel gyi phung po ltar gsal zhing chos skor du 'khor ba dang sku'i cha thams cad nas bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun dri ma med pa dang utpal dkar po'i ze'u 'bru las/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ rje btsun sgrol ma rab tu zhi ba gzhan gyi stobs (547)skyabs bzlu ba med pa dkon mchog gsum gyis/ gsang sngags dang rigs sngags gzungs sngags rnams kyi/ don dam rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i bden pa dang kun rdzob rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i/ khyad par du bcom ldan 'das ma 'phang ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi/ bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis rang bzhin skye gnas kyi bar do nas chos nyid dang srid pa'i bar dor kha brgyud de 'khyar ba'i tshe 'das/

che ge mo'i rnam par shes pa 'gro ba rigs drug skye gnas rnam pa bzhi/ srid pa bar ma do gang du gnas kyang snying rje chen po dang gsang sngags zab mo'i bden pas rten 'di la mchis par gyur cig lan gsum dang mthar/ rnam par shes pa 'od kyi rang bzhin tu rten la thim par gyur cig ja hūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ phyag rgya bzhis ming byang dang dbyer med du gyur/ de nas (548) phyir 'brang gi gshed dang bgegs sbyang ba'i phyir/ gtor ma chog ldog gsum re re nas rten la bskor te/ oṃ sarba bhighan sogs mthar/ tshe las 'das pa'i sdig pa sbyang ba la bar du gcod pa'i lan pa'i bgegs rnams la gtor ma 'di brngan du sbyin gyis sogs zhig zhes sbrel ba lan gsum ring lo chang bu dang bcas bskor zhing*/ suṃ bha na ིsa mthar/ ting lo 'dis snang ba dang*/ chung bu 'dis lam rgyags gyis la sogs zhig ces sbre ba gang dum gyi mthar/ oṃ/ rang bzhin mnyam pa chen po las/ sogs mthar/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bar dang hūm̐ bzhin yungs thun brab/ oṃ sprul pa ye shes sgyu ma las/ sogs nas/ hūm̐ phaṭa/ utpal dang rdo rje spe ma'i gur khang 'phrigs pas srung zhing gshed kyis gnod pas mi tshugs par bsam/ de nas rten gyi g.yas su mi/ g.yon du chu/ mdun du rim bzhag la/ tshe 'das (549)zil gyis mnan pa mang po nyi zer gyi rdul lta bu 'phros pas tshe 'das la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i lha dang lha min dang*/ nam mkha' lding mi'i ci dri za lto 'phye srin po'i tshogs gang su yang rung ba rnams kyi stobs dang sde rnams tshar bcad sdig sgrib thams cad ba mo la nyi zer phog pa bzhin snang la rang bzhin ma grub pa chos nyid stong pa nyid du sbyar bar dmigs te/ rtsa sngags shams/ sarba pā paṃ ga te ga te swā hā/ 'a.a ha sha sa ma/ ma ma ko ling sa manta tshe las 'das pa'i las sgrib bag chags shintaṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ rigs drug klong grol dang 'khor ba dong sprug gnyis dmigs rnam sprod te ci mang du bzlas/

mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis mchod yon phul bas/ bum pa'i lha rnams bde stong chen po'i ngo bor (550)'do du zhu nas dag byed kyi chu nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ de nas sbyang ba la 'jug par bya te/ thog mar rten la 'gug pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las dkyil 'khor gyi sgo rta bab kyi 'og tu padma dang zla ba'i steng tu nṛ yongs su gyur pa las tshe 'das kyi phung po dang skye mched gson gyi gnas skabs ji ltar bar yod par gyur/ bdag nyid kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu'i rnam pa can grangs med pa 'jig rten gyi khams su khyab par 'phros pas tshe 'das rigs drug gi bar do dang skye gnas gang na 'dug pa rang dbang med par bkug te mdun gyi ming byang dang gnyis su med par bye ma la chu thim pa ltar gnyis med du bstim par dmigs te/ na mo/ byin brlabs kyi rtsa ba bla ma rnams kyi bden pa dang*/ (551)kyi sdig sgrib thams cad kaṃ nag po'i rnam par gnas pa lte ba'i rlung gis ded nas rna sgo sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par thon til la thim pa ye shes kyi mes bsreg chos nyid kyi rgya mtshor dor nas sdig sgrib dag par bsam/ rtsa sngags dang*/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmi ku ru swā hā/ che ge mo'i/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sarba pā pāṃ shintaṃ ku ru swā hā/ gsang sngags zab mo bzlas 'i bye ma brab cing*/ sgrol ma'i rigs sngags/ arte marte sogs sngags yang bzla'o/ de nas zhus bum thog te/ bdag mdun gyi gnas dang sku'i cha thams cad nas sgrol ma rab tu zhi ba dkar mo bdud rtsi'i bum pa bsnams pa mang po nyi zer gyi rdul ltar 'tshub pas khams sum rigs drug gi gnas thams cad la khyab par 'phros tshe las 'das pa gtso bor gyur pa'i sems can thams cad kyi spyi bo nas khrus byas (552)pas tshe rabs nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad dbang po'i sgo dang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas nag nyil gyis byung nas rang bzhin med par dag lus sems zag med kyi bde bas gang bar dmigs te/

tām̐ḥ phyag 'tshal bde ma dge ma zhi ma dang mya ngan 'das zhi spyod yul nyid ma/ swā hā oṃ dang yang dag ldan pas/ sdig pa chen po'i 'jom pa nyid ma/ rtsa sngags dang*/ kaṃ ka ni/ yig brgya gang mang brjod/ de nas/ ho/ 'di ni ye shes sgo ma bzhi/ sbyin pa'i chu yis legs bkrub pas/ ser sna'i dri ma sbyang mdzad cing*/ khrus legs mdzad kyis khrus bgyi'o/ rtsa sngags dang*/ kaṃ ka ni dang*/ yig brgya brjod/ ho/ sangs rgyas kun gyi phrin las rdzogs/ bya grub ye shes tshul khrims chus/ 'chal ba'i dri ma sbyang mdzad pas/ khrus legs/ rtsa sngags kaṃ ka ni dang yig brgya brjod/ ho/ sangs rgyas kun gyi mi shig (553)gsung por rtogs ye shes bzod pa'i chus/ khang khro'i dri ma/ khrus legs/ rtsa sngags/ ho/ sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan rdzogs/ mnyam nyid ye shes brtson 'grus chus/ le lo'i dri ma/ khrus legs/ ho/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i thugs/ me slong ye shes bsam gtan/ rnam g.yeng dri ma/ khrus legs/ ho/ chos dbyings ye shes rnam par dag 'jigs pa brgyad skyob shes rab chus/ gti mug dri ma/ khrus legs/ rtsa sngags kaṃ ka ni dang*/ yig brgya brjod/ de nas 'byung ba'i dug sbyang ba ni/ sa ni dug gi pha yin te/ sa ni dug gi pha yang yin/ rdo rje yum gyi byin rlabs kyis/ dus gsum sa yi nang du song*/ chu ni dug gi pha yin/ chu ni dug gi ma/ rin chen yum gyi byin brlabs kyis/ dug gsum chu yi/ me ni dug gi pha/ me ni dug gi ma/ padma yum gyi byin (554)rlabs kyis/ dug gsum me yi nang du song*/ rlung ni dug gi pha/ rlung ni dug gi ma yang*/ las kyi yum/ dug gsum rlung gi nang du song*/ rtsa sngags dang*/ muṃ laṃ māṃ pāṃ twaṃ/ che ge mo'i/ 'byung ba'i rgyu rkyen las byung ba'i/ dug thams cad shintaṃ ku ru swā hā/ bden pa'i stobs kyis dug gzhal pa ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum/

'di dag tshe 'das dug gsum ste/ bcom ldan sangs rgyas dug mi mnga'/ sangs rgyas bden pas dgu bcom mo/ 'dod chags zhe sdang*/ 'di dag tshe 'das/ bcom ldan dam chos/ dam chos bden pas/ 'dod chags zhe sdang*/ 'di dag tshe 'das/ bcom ldan dge 'dun/ dge 'dun pas dgu bcom/ che ge mo/ nyon mongs pa dug gsum thams cad dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pas shintaṃ ku ru swā hā/ de nas shigs brjod pa ni/ byang chub snying por gshegs pa na/ sa rnams (555)drug po g.yos gyur cing*/ bdud yid mi bder gyur pa des/ khyed la bde legs mjad par gyur/ khyed cag sdig par ma gyur cig chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba na/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnanams gsung zhing*/ thub pa'i snyan pa gang byung des/ khyed cag yid 'phrog gang zhig mu stegs byed/ thams cad chos kyis pham mdzad cing*/ tshogs kun dbang du mdzad pa des/ khyed la/ khyed cag tshe las 'das pas gtsos sems can thams cad sdig pa'i phyogs las rgyal zhing shintu bkra shis par gyur cig de nas dbang bskur ba ni nye du la sogs pa'i yid gtsug pa zhig gis byang du bzung ste/ ho/ kun mkhyen sangs rgyas phung po can/ srid pa'i 'khor lo rnam sbyang ba/ gtso bos bshad pa'i rin chen gter/ de ring bdag la bka' drin rtsol/ lan gsum skyabs 'gro ni/ oṃ deng (556)nas bla med byang chub bar/ sogs dang sems bskyed ni/ aḥ skye rga na 'chi'i/ sogs dang sdom bzung ni/ oṃ ye nas gsang chen nges pa'i bka'/ sogs nas/ mthu yod bya bar btang*/ de nas byin 'bebs ni spro na bzhugs nas/ oṃ phyogs bcu'i sogs dang min kyang rtsa sngags mthar/ a we sha ya sa ma ya ja jaḥpheṃ pheṃ zhes byin rlabs pas/ tshe 'das phung khams skye mched 'phags ma'i sku gsung thugs su byin rlabs so/ de ltar tshe 'das ltar gsal ba la dbang bskur ba la gsol ba 'debs pa ni/ ho/ dkyil 'khor gtso bo bdag la dgongs/

sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pas na/ de phyir rgyal ba'i yum du grags/ sgrol ma'i dbugs rtsal tu gsol/ lan gsum lan du/ ho/ 'di nas byang chub ma thob par/ dam tshig sdom pa la gnas zhing*/ byang chub sems ni mi btang na/ lha yi 'khar lo sbyin par bya/ zhes dang slos mas/ sras bcas rgyal ba ma lus pa'i (557)byang chub spyod lam snying rje dang*/ byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi na/ thugs rje su bzung bar mdzod/ dbang dngos las dang po bum pa'i rdo rje'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag te/ oṃ/ gang dag phyogs bcu'i khams bzhugs pa'i/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis byin rlabs pa/ rgyal ba ma lus bskyed pa'i yum/ sku yi dbang bskur khyed kyis longs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ta re badzra sta na sarba ta thā ga ta badzra ta na hūm̐/ rin po che phyag rgya'am phreng phrin par bzhag la/ oṃ/ gang dag phyogs bcu'i khams/ sangs rgyas rnams/ rgyal ba ma lus/ gsung gi dbyigs su deng gyur cig oṃ sarba ta tha ga ta tā re tsitta ma ni dzwa la ni sarba ta tha ga ta ma hā shuddha sa ri shuddhe ye swā hā/

dam tshig phyag rgya'am utpal snying kar bzhag la/ hūm̐ gang dag phyogs bcu'i/ sangs rgyas/ rgyal ba/ thugs kyi dbang bskur khyod kyis long*/ (558)oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badzra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur ro/ 'dod yon bsngo ba nam mkha'i mjod kyi sngags dang pyag rgyas spel te/ gsur rdzas rnams yid du 'ong ba'i gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i bye brag cir yang 'char ba zag pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/ hūm̐/ 'jin rten khams ni rab 'byams na/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya'i tshogs/ gcig las brgya stong grang med 'phro/ yid la bde ba'i dpal stair ba/ rdze btsun 'phags mas byin rlabs pa/ tshe 'das khyed la bsngos pa yis/ byang chub bar du zad med cing*/ skye dang skye ba thams cad du/ longs spyod zad pa med pa dang*/ 'phags pa'i nor gyis phyug par shog ces bsngo/ lam bstan snang gsal 'od 'phro ba gcig tan te/ gson cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu/ sprul pa'i zhing khams po ta la/ padma drwa ba can gyi zhing*/ sna tshogs khams kyis rnal 'byor spras/ (559)sgrib pa mi mnga' mngon sum du/ sangs rgyas ma chags padma'i spyan/ yid can bde bar dbugs 'byin pa/ 'phags ma de yi mtshan bzung pas/ zhing mchog de ru skye bar 'gyur/ yid gnyis spong la der gshegs shig ces tshe 'das kyi sgo gsum tāṃ yig ljang gu gyur te skar mda' rgyug pa ltar song nas rje btsun ma'i thugs kar thim nas dbyer med ro gcig 'dres pa bsam la tam̐ bdun brtsegs mthar phaṭa kyis rgyas gdab/ byang bu bsregs pa ni/ nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu/ phung po lnga yi bud shing la/ rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me sbar ro/ 'byung ba lnga yi bud shing la/ gshegs ma lnga yi/ lus ngag yid gsum/ rgyal ba sku gsung thugs/ sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan par/ 'gro ba'i don tu 'grub par shog ces/ rang nyid rje btsun mi thugs las bdag med rtog pa'i so so rang rig pa'i ye shes kyi rtsal mi dpung kha dog

(560)lnga ldan lam bden gyi ngo bo 'phros tshe 'das kyi spang bya sgrib pa thams cad rang bzhin med par sbyang bar gyur/ rtsa sngags dang rtsa rigs kaṃ ka ni yig brgya mang du brjod/ thal bas rtsa tsha grub par bya/ de tsha bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam gyis rgyas gdab par bya'o/ ser sngo gdams mtshog ster gi gnas sbyang 'di lam la mos pa dbon tshul khrims bzo yang dang yang du bskul ba'i ngor chos kyi bdag po padma las 'brel rtsal gyis rang gzhung rtsa ba'i dgongs pa dang mthun par phrin las bsam snyigs mi tshe 'das gnas ngan pa'i sdug bsngal zhi nas bde ba mtshog gi go 'phang la 'god pa'i rgyur gyur cig maṅga laṃ/// /
